system.description:
The Solar channels the entire kinetic principle of her art into a single crushing blow of absolute devastation. Supplementing a Martial Arts attack, this charm adds the Solar's (Strength + Essence) to the raw damage of the strike, making it a blow capable of caving walls and shattering armored combatants. The concussive shockwave generated by the impact forces the target to succeed on a (Stamina + Resistance) roll at difficulty 3 or be knocked back (Essence) yards and knocked prone.

Any object, structure, or barrier that is not magically reinforced is automatically destroyed if struck with this charm, regardless of its mundane durability. Against targets who are already prone or otherwise disadvantaged, the charm adds an additional die to the damage roll for each existing penalty the target suffers from knockback, wounds, or environmental conditions. This charm is the prerequisite for Storm Burst Explosion.
